description: Given a website domain, returns the business name and its source, the published contact surface, and the technology platforms the site runs (analytics, tag managers, email marketing, SEO and more), each with its detection evidence. Every claim is checked against that evidence; unsupported ones are struck on Agent Harbor's own hardware. Not charged if the page cannot be used. Free prompt-injection scan included. May take up to ~100 s; near that, the public URL can cut a call off (HTTP 524). Costs $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, no scheme or path, e.g. mailchimp.com
